# Ocean In Motion (O.I.M.)

> Ocean In Motion is a business growth agency that connects branding, websites, SEO, GEO (AI search optimization), social media, AI implementation, automation and business strategy into one integrated system. Philosophy: "Not more marketing. A better foundation." Founded by Ocean Saywack. Serves businesses across the Southeast region of the United States, and works with clients remotely.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://ocean-in-motion.com/): What O.I.M. does and how the pieces connect.
- [About](https://ocean-in-motion.com/about/): Why O.I.M. exists and the foundation-first approach.
- [Packages](https://ocean-in-motion.com/packages/): Anchor (brand foundation, from $600), Harbor (website, from $1,000), Current (ongoing SEO and GEO), Tide (social media management), Fleet (partnership) and Horizon (business growth partnership). Monthly packages are custom proposals.
- [Brands](https://ocean-in-motion.com/brands/): Brands and websites built by O.I.M. — Ability Plumbing & Co., Ethan's Reach, K.C. & Roscoe, Narci, Ocean Music, KMS Sequence, Cinimod, Mel Carter Photography and a dealership website.
- [Contact](https://ocean-in-motion.com/contact/): Start a project. Email oceaninmotionco@gmail.com; replies within 1-2 business days.
- Case studies: [Ability Plumbing](https://ocean-in-motion.com/work/ability-plumbing/), [Ethan's Reach](https://ocean-in-motion.com/work/ethans-reach/), [K.C. & Roscoe](https://ocean-in-motion.com/work/kc-and-roscoe/).

## Services
Branding and brand identity; custom websites; SEO and GEO; Google Business Profile; social media management; content and video; print and vehicle graphics; AI implementation and automation; CRM and business consulting.
